data.title: 尤贝尔 · 冬夜的缝补失败
data.description: 旅馆房间，她试图缝补裙摆的破口，针脚歪歪扭扭最后打了个巨大的结；盯着成品看了三秒，决定「这样也行」，是她不靠谱的生活面。
data.action: 旅馆房间，她试图缝补裙摆的破口，针脚歪歪扭扭最后打了个巨大的结
data.promptProse: At the inn table, Ubel holds a needle above crooked stitches in her charcoal cardigan sleeve, staring patiently at the tangled thread knot. The cardigan layers over a cream blouse and long skirt, green hair falling toward the repair. The medium view places the sewing kit beside folded fabric and the room wall behind. Warm lamplight gathers on the stitches and her puzzled eyes, leaving the table's far corner dim.
